data.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
DD4: plugins/dso/docs/precondition-marker-consumers.md enumerates all references to EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark string

## What
After all cluster instrumentation tasks complete (T3/T4/T5), grep all files in the repo for EMIT-PRECONDITIONS. Create plugins/dso/docs/precondition-marker-consumers.md listing every consumer with file path and description of how it uses the landmark.

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/docs/precondition-marker-consumers.md (NEW)

## Consumer Manifest Structure
| File | Usage | Notes |
|------|-------|-------|
| plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md | fallthrough site instrumentation | <gate_name> sites |
| ... | ... | ... |
| (future) hooks/... | SC3 hook landmark detection | Not yet implemented |

## TDD Exemption
Static doc artifact with no conditional logic — criterion 3 (static assets only per Rule 5).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] plugins/dso/docs/precondition-marker-consumers.md exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/precondition-marker-consumers.md
- [ ] Consumer manifest lists all 11 instrumented skill files
  Verify: grep -c 'plugins/dso/skills/' plugins/dso/docs/precondition-marker-consumers.md | awk '{exit ($1 < 11)}'
- [ ] EMIT-PRECONDITIONS string appears in the manifest
  Verify: grep -q 'EMIT-PRECONDITIONS' plugins/dso/docs/precondition-marker-consumers.md
- [ ] All instrumented files are referenced (cross-check with T3/T4/T5)
  Verify: for f in brainstorm/SKILL.md brainstorm/phases/approval-gate.md sprint/SKILL.md sprint/prompts/auto-resume.md sprint/prompts/test-failure-dispatch-protocol.md preplanning/SKILL.md implementation-plan/SKILL.md debug-everything/SKILL.md fix-bug/SKILL.md validate-work/SKILL.md shared/workflows/epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md; do grep -q "$f" plugins/dso/docs/precondition-marker-consumers.md || { echo "Missing: $f"; exit 1; }; done
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
